# Check-Plagiarism

> A comprehensive AI-powered writing integrity platform offering plagiarism detection, AI content analysis, grammar checking, and paraphrasing tools available in 15+ languages.

Check-Plagiarism provides free and premium writing tools designed for students, educators, and content creators to ensure academic integrity and improve writing quality. The platform leverages advanced AI technology to detect plagiarism, identify AI-generated content, and assist with writing refinement across multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Plagiarism Detection
- AI Detection

- Grammar Checker

- Content Verification

## Core Writing Tools

- [Plagiarism Checker](https://www.check-plagiarism.com/free-tools): Hub of free writing tools: plagiarism checker, AI detector, grammar checker.
- [AI Detector](https://www.check-plagiarism.com/ai-detector): Free AI detector to identify ChatGPT and human-generated content.
- [Paraphrasing Tool](https://www.check-plagiarism.com/paraphrasing-tool): AI-powered paraphrasing tool for students and writers to rephrase text.
- [Grammar Checker](https://www.check-plagiarism.com/grammar-checker): Free AI grammar checker for spelling, punctuation and clarity analysis.
